learning_outcomes.text: Identify the different components of the physical and logical computer system.
Understand the function of an operating system as a manager of the computer's physical system.
Operate the most common operating systems.
Use editing, compilation, and execution tools to develop programs.
Use different control structures to develop programs.
Use different data structures to develop programs.
Perform tests to validate developed programs.
Know computer tools for planning engineering projects.

syllabus_topics: Physical organization of a computer: Hardware

assessment_methods.method: Practical exam/test and/or evaluation of practical assignments

assessment_rules: The recovery evaluation will consist of a theoretical-practical exam recovering evaluation activities one and two. Students who do not obtain a 5 (out of 10) in this recovery will not be able to average with the third section, and their final grade will be the one obtained in this exam (out of 10 points). A minimum grade of 5 is required for the theoretical-practical exam.
